table.name: characteristics
table.summary: A lookup table defining standardized product or item characteristics, such as quality grades, purity levels, and speed ratings.

characteristic_id.name: characteristic_id
characteristic_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each characteristic record.

characteristic_type_code.name: characteristic_type_code
characteristic_type_code.meaning: Categorical code representing the nature of the characteristic (e.g., Grade, Purity).
